author: mari.trail
caption: Saturday group run is ON 🌄 Meeting at the Pedra Grande trailhead, 6:00 AM. 14 km, easy pace, nobody gets left behind. Bring water and a headlamp for the first 20 minutes. Comment if you're in!

comments.author: ju.corre
comments.text: In!! Bringing the coffee thermos ☕

comments.author: rafa.ultra
comments.text: Count me in. Headlamp charged.

comments.author: pedro.peak
comments.text: First time with the group, is 14 km ok for a beginner?

comments.author: mari.trail
comments.text: @pedro.peak totally, we stop at every viewpoint 😉

author: rafa.ultra
caption: Shoe question for the group: my old pair finally died after 900 km. Looking for something with more grip for wet rocks. What are you all running in these days?

comments.author: thiago.serra
comments.text: Anything with 5mm lugs. Grip over cushion for Serra do Mar.

comments.author: carol.runs
comments.text: Whatever you pick, break them in before race day 🙏

comments.author: leo.trilha
comments.text: This is why we wake up early.

comments.author: bia.montanha
comments.text: WHERE is this??

comments.author: ju.corre
comments.text: @bia.montanha the ridge after the second stream crossing, you know it 😄

author: bia.montanha
caption: RACE RECAP 🏁 Finished my first 42k trail yesterday. Cried at km 30, laughed at km 40, ate everything at the finish. Thank you to everyone in this group who told me I could do it. You were right.

comments.author: mari.trail
comments.text: SO proud of you!!! 🎉🎉

comments.author: rafa.ultra
comments.text: Welcome to the marathon club. Next: 50k 👀

comments.author: carol.runs
comments.text: Rest week now, doctor's orders 😂

comments.author: ju.corre
comments.text: Legend.

author: leo.trilha
caption: Halfway break with the best view in the state. Sometimes the run is just an excuse to sit here.

comments.author: thiago.serra
comments.text: That rock is the official group bench at this point.

author: thiago.serra
caption: TRAIL UPDATE ⚠️ The ridge section after the antenna is very exposed and windy right now. Rangers recommend turning back before noon this week. Stay safe and tell the group if you go.

comments.author: mari.trail
comments.text: Pinning this to the rules for the week. Thanks Thiago!

comments.author: pedro.peak
comments.text: Good to know, was planning to go Thursday.

author: carol.runs
caption: Physio tip of the week 🦵 If your knees hurt on downhills, shorten your stride and let your arms do more. Land under your body, not in front of it. Try it on Saturday and tell me if it helped.

comments.author: bia.montanha
comments.text: This fixed my knees last month. Trust her.

comments.author: leo.trilha
comments.text: Saving this 🙌

author: pedro.peak
caption: Hi everyone! New to the group and new to trails. I've been running on the road for 3 years and my friend dragged me to the mountains last weekend. I'm sore, I'm scratched, and I'm hooked. Any tips for a beginner?

comments.author: mari.trail
comments.text: Welcome Pedro! Join Saturday's run, that's tip #1 🤝

comments.author: rafa.ultra
comments.text: Walk the uphills. Everybody does. Nobody admits it.

comments.author: ju.corre
comments.text: Tip: more snacks than you think you need.

author: ju.corre
caption: Lake stop! 🏞️ We made it to the top and nobody wanted to go back down. Post-run swim was not planned but 10/10 recommend.

comments.author: leo.trilha
comments.text: The water was FREEZING and I would do it again.

comments.author: bia.montanha
comments.text: Next time I'm bringing a towel 😂

author: mari.trail
caption: Reminder from your admin 💚 Leave no trace. Take your gel wrappers home, stay on the marked path, and say hi to the hikers. We share this mountain. Full rules are in the community menu.

comments.author: carol.runs
comments.text: Picked up 3 wrappers last Saturday. Not ours, but still.
